title: Razor Ramon vs. Shawn Michaels: dueling champions
summary: A disputed Intercontinental championship is settled with a ladder. A later rematch revisits the rivalry with Michaels defending the title.

chapters.title: Razor wins the WrestleMania ladder match
chapters.result: Razor Ramon defeats Shawn Michaels to settle the Intercontinental title dispute.
chapters.context: Both championship belts hang above the ring.

chapters.title: Michaels wins the ladder rematch
chapters.result: Shawn Michaels retains against Razor Ramon.
chapters.context: The rivalry resumes with the championship roles reversed.
